description: Return Crivum's public rubric by work type, the tier ladder, the thresholds, the minimum score for a citable record and what Crivum accepts and refuses, each with a version number. No API key required. Use before calling evaluate_text, or to show a user what a score decomposes into. Gatilho em português: "quais são os critérios da Crivum".
name: get_criteria
title: Read Crivum's public scoring criteria
